findings.evidence: Representable.lean:61 `abbrev CoordinateRing := Localization.Away (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℤ)`; diff `abbrev ChangeRing : Type _ := Localization.Away (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) B)`; Representable.lean:76 `def change` vs diff `def universalChange`; Representable.lean:109 `specialize` := `IsLocalization.Away.lift ... eval₂Hom (Int.castRingHom R) ![C.u, C.r, C.s, C.t]`, which is the body of `lift` at `B = ℤ`; the new module docstring says only in prose that for `B = ℤ` this is `Universal.CoordinateRing`.
findings.fix: Make `Universal.CoordinateRing := ChangeRing ℤ` and `Universal.change := universalChange ℤ`. Define `specialize C := lift (Int.castRingHom R, C)` and derive `ringHomEquiv` from `lift`. Alternatively, delete the `CoordinateRing` copy and move its in-repo uses to `ChangeRing ℤ`. Either way, keep one universal change per ring.
findings.issue: Duplicated API. `ChangeRing ℤ` is literally the same type as the existing `Universal.CoordinateRing` (both are `Localization.Away (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℤ)`). Several pairs do the same job: `universalChange ℤ` and `Universal.change`, `universalChange_u/r/s/t` and `change_u/r/s/t`, `lift (Int.castRingHom R, C)` and `VariableChange.specialize C`, and `ChangeRing.ringHom_ext` and `Universal.ringHom_ext`. `ringHomEquiv` is the `B = ℤ` case of `lift`. The two copies are never connected, so users get two incompatible universal changes on the same ring and no lemma relating them.

summary: The new general `ChangeRing B` API makes the existing `Universal.CoordinateRing` API a second public copy of the same ring: `CoordinateRing` is the same ring as `ChangeRing ℤ`, and nothing connects the two copies. The rest of the surface (lift/ringHom_ext/pushoutLift, the structure maps and their characteristic simp lemmas) is adequate.
